tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rgyal yum snying po'i rnam bshad nyin byed dbang po bzhugs so/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ /'khor 'das 'ching grol kun gyi
༄༅/ /rgyal yum snying po'i rnam bshad nyin byed dbang po bzhugs so/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ /'khor 'das 'ching grol kun gyi

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyal yum snying po'i rnam bshad nyin byed dbang po bzhugs so// sras bcas rgyal ba'i bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ /'khor 'das 'ching grol kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ /gsal stong zung du 'jug pa chos kyi dbyings/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal nas/ /'bum sde lnga las zab mo stong pa nyid/ /brjod byar ston pa sher phyin thugs kyi 'bum/ /de don bsdus pa rgyal yum snying po'i mdo/ /theg mchog bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyas phyir bshad/ /dag pa'i 'don thabs them yig brgya yis btab/ /go bde'i 'chad tshul tshig don lhug par bkral/ /zab mo'i nyams len gnad kyi bsdus don bstan/ /de ltar gsum las dang po ni/ lhag chad bral ba'i mdo 'di la sh+lau ka nyi shu rtsa bdun yod/ med pa sum cu rtsa bdun te/ /de ni nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ /te ni bcu gcig mtha' rten gyi/ /de te gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ /da rten de zhes brjod bya ste/ /med de yod de bshad de'o/ /na sa ra la te byung ste/ /yin te gnyis te ma nor te/ /gal te zhes pa lta bu'o/ /rigs bu zung sbyar gnyis dang ni/ /ya gyal rigs bu gcig tu yod/ /shā ri'i bu ni brgyad po la/ /dwa ba ti ni gnyis su yod/ /de yang gnyis pa tha ma 'o/ /rgyal ba'i bka' ni gsum ka tshang / /gnyis pa 'chad tshul la/ lo tsā bas bkod pa'i rgya bod kyi mtshan bshad de yum la phyag 'tshal ba dang / yum sher phyin gyi tshig don zhib tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan bshad pa dang phyag 'tshal ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgya gar skad du bha ga wa ti pradzñā pa ra mi ta hri da ya/ bod skad du bcom ldan ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po zhes so/ /de yang cung zad bshad na/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul na skad rigs mi 'dra ba bzhi yod pa'i nang nas/ legs par sbyar ba saṃskṛ ta lha yi skad du zab mo'i mdo 'di'i mtshan la/ bha ga wa ti pradzñā pa ra mi ta hri da ya zhes 'byung /

de bod skad du bsgyur na/ bha ga wa ti ni bcom ldan 'das ma/ pradzñā ni shes rab/ pa ra ni pha rol/ mi ta ni phyin pa/ hri da ya snying po zhes pa gcig 'byung / mtshan de'i don bshad na/ de yang bcom ldan ni bdud bzhi bcom zhing dbang phyug gi yon tan drug dang ldan pa la snga rabs pa dag 'chad cing / 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyis bzhi bcom drug ldan la 'chad pa bkag mod/ gang ltar yang spang bya mi mthun pa'i tshogs thams cad bcom zhing / thob bya yon tan gyi tshogs mtha' dag dang ldan pas na bcom ldan no/ /'das ni rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi phyir na so so'i skye bo dang nyan thos dang rang rgyal dang rgyal sras 'phags pa'i mchog rnams kyi yang spyod yul las 'das so zhes pa ni/ rgya dpe la med pa lo tsā bas bkod pa'i tshig go /ma ni/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba ma lus pa bskyed par byed pa'i yum yin pa'i don gyis na ma'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ gzhung lam 'bras bu'i sher phyin gsum la skabs gzhan du bshad cing / 'dir rnam grangs gsum gyi sgo nas bshad na/ shes pa ni/ skye 'gro mtha' dag gi rgyud la yod pa'i gsal rig tsam mo/ /rab ni/ de las rab dang mchog tu gyur pa thos bsam las byung ba'i shes rab bo/ /pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ snga ma de gnyis las pha rol mchog tu phyin pas na pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /snying po ni/ tshig nyung ngus sher phyin gyi mdo mtha' dag gi brjod don ston par byed pas na snying po'o/ /gnyis pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa ste/ zab mo'i mdo 'di bsgyur ba'i bar chad zhi ba'i ched du lo tsā bas bkod do/ /gnyis pa yum sher phyin gyi tshig don zhib tu bshad pa la/ phun sum tshogs pa bzhi spyir bstan pa dang / chos phun sum tshogs pa bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ dus/ ston pa/ gnas/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa dang bzhi/

dang po ni/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na zhes pas bstan/ 'di yang don gsum gyis bshad par byas te/ 'di skad thos/ bdag gis thos/ dus gcig na thos zhes pas te/ dang po ni/ chos 'di'i skad tsam thos kyi don zab mo ni ma rtogs zhes chos 'di rtogs dka' bar bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ bka' bsdu ba po dag gis ston pa las dngos su thos kyi gzhan las brgyud pa ni ma yin no zhes chos 'di sgro bskur dang bral bar bstan/ gsum pa ni/ dus gcig na chos 'di thos/ dus gzhan du chos gzhan dang gzhan thos zhes bka' bsdu ba po mang du thos pa'i yon tan che bar bstan to/ /gnyis pa ston pa phun sum tshogs pa ni bcom ldan 'das zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa gnas phun sum tshogs pa ni rgyal po'i khab bya rgod phung po'i ri la zhes pas bstan cing / rgyal po'i khab ni rgyal po'i khang bzangs/ bya rgod phung po'i ri ni bya rgod spungs pa dang 'dra ba'i ri ste/ khyim pa dang rab tu byung ba gnyis kyi gnas kyi dbye ba yin no/ /bzhi pa 'khor phun sum tshogs pa ni/ dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs te zhes pas bstan/ de yang dge slong gi dge 'dun ni bsnyen par rdzogs pa sha stag go /chen po la gnyis te/ grangs kyi che ba ni lnga stong tsam mo/ /yon tan gyi che ba ni thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa zhes sogs so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po ni byang ba rang don spangs pa phun sum tshogs/ chub pa gzhan don rtogs pa phun tshogs te mthar thug gi spangs rtogs dbyer med kyi byang chub yang dang yang du sems par byed pa'o/ /chen po la gnyis te/ grangs kyi che ba ni bzang skyong la sogs pa tshad med pa bye ba phrag khrig ces so/ /yon tan kyi che ba ni sa thob pa sha stag ste rgyal ba'i yum las gsungs pa ltar ro/ /thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa ni ston 'khor dus mtshungs pa la bya'o/

/gnyis pa chos phun sum tshogs pa la/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka'/ zhal nas gsungs pa'i bka'/ rjes su gnang ba'i bka' dang gsum/ dang po la ji ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshul dngos/ yum sher phyin gyi rang bzhin gtan la phab pa/ sher phyin dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum du bstan pa/ yum sher phyin sngags dang gnyis su med pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la ting nge 'dzin gang gis byin gyis brlabs pa/ gang zag gang byin gyis brlabs pa/ tshul ji ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das zab mo snang ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so zhes pas bstan/ de'i don ston 'khor lhan cig tu 'tshogs pa de'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'das rtogs par dka' ba/ zab mo stong pa nyid yul snang gi rnam par shar ba/ snang stong zung 'jug ces bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs kyi ting nge 'dzin la rtse gcig tu snyoms par zhugs so zhes pa'o/ /'di ni 'og nas 'byung ba'i mdo mtha' dag gi brjod don gyi lus mdor bstan pa yin no/ /gzhan dag gis zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin gdul bya'i rgyud la snang bar byed pa zhes 'bru snon pas ni mdo'i don ma rtogs so/ /gnyis pa gang zag gang byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs dang shā ri'i bu gnyis byin gyis brlabs/ gsum pa tshul ji ltar byin gyis brlabs pa la/ spyan ras gzigs lan 'debs pa por byin gyis brlabs pa/ shā ri'i bu dri ba byed pa por byin gyis brlabs pa/ dris pa'i lan gyis sher phyin la lta tshul mdor bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ yang de'i tshe zhes sogs kyis bstan/ de'i don ston pa ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag par ma zad/ yang de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po so so skye bo'i sa las ring du 'phags pa thugs rje'i spyan ras kyis sems can kyi don la nyin mtshan dus drug du gzigs shing yon tan du ma la mnga' brnyes pa'i dbang phyug ste/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i zab mo'i spyod pa nyid la rnam par blta zhing phung po lnga po de dag la yang ye gdod ma nas rang bzhin gyis stong par rnam par blta'o/ /gnyis pa shā ri'i bu byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la dri ba 'di skad ces smras so/ /ji ltar smras na/ shā ri'i bu rang gi stan las langs nas bla gos phrag pa g.yon la bzar/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te dris pa ni/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo'i spyod pa spyad par 'dod pa des ji ltar bslab par bya/ de skad ces smras pa dang zhes so/ /de yang shā ri'i bu ni yab shā ri kas te'i bu yin pa'i don gyis na de skad ces bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu ni rigs can gsum ci rigs pas bsdus pa'i rten skyes pa/ rigs kyi bu mo ni rigs can gsum ci rigs pas bsdus pa'i rten bud med do/ /zab mo'i spyod pa spyad par 'dod pa ni stong nyid zab mo rtogs pa'i spyod pa dang spyad cing nyams su len par 'dod pa des zhes pa'o/ /gsum pa dris pa'i lan gyis sher phyin la lta tshul mdor bstan pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis tshe dang ldan pa shā ra dwa ti'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /shā ri'i bu rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo'i spyod pa spyad par 'dod pa des 'di ltar rnam par lta bar bya ste phung po lnga po de dag kyang rang bzhin gyis stong par yang dag par rjes su blta'o/ /gnyis pa yum sher phyin gyi rang bzhin gtan la phab pa la myong ba mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du shar tshul/ rtogs pa zab mo brgyad ldan du thob tshul/

'khor 'das yul gyi 'dzin pa las grol tshul/ des na sher phyin nyams su blang bar gdams pa/ nyams su blangs pa'i sher phyin gyi phan yon dang lnga'o/ /'di dag la 'chad tshul gnyis te/ dngos bstan stong pa nyid kyi ldog pa nas bshad tshul dang / sbas don gsal rig sems kyi ldog pa nas bshad tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ de ltar ston pa'i thugs rjes 'khor thun mong ba rnams kyis kyang yum gyi don rtogs pa'i tshe/ 'khor 'das yul snang gi chos thams cad myong ba mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du shar tshul ni/ gzugs la dngos 'dzin dang bral bas stong pa nyid du nyams su myong ba ni/ gzugs stong pa'o zhes pas bstan/ nyams myong stong pa nyid yul snang gzugs kyi rnam par shar ba ni/ stong pa nyid gzugs so zhes pas bstan/ de ltar snang stong gnyis gcig spangs nas cig shos grub pa med pas/ gzugs las stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin/ stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no zhes pas bstan/ mdor na gzugs stong pa'o zhes pas snang med kyi rnal 'byor bstan/ stong pa nyid gzugs so zhes pas snang bcas kyi rnal 'byor bstan/ gzugs las stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin/ stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no zhes pas zung 'jug bgrod pa gcig pa'i nyams len bstan pa ni gnad kyi don te 'og nas rgyas par 'chad do/ /gzugs myong ba mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du shar ba de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa rnams stong pa'o zhes pas te/ phung po lhag ma rnams kyang mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du shes par bya'o/ /snang stong dbyer med mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du 'char ba'i dpe ni/ chu nang du shar ba'i zla ba'i gzugs brnyan zla bar snang yang zla bas stong pa dang / rmi lam gyi rta glang sad pa'i tshe rta glang du snang yang rta glang gis stong tshul/ dbang yid kyi shes pa gnyis la sbyar ba'i dpes thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams myong bskyed par bya'o/

/gnyis pa zab mo rtogs pa brgyad ldan du thob tshul ni/ shā ri'i bu de ltar chos thams cad stong pa nyid de/ mtshan nyid med pa/ ma skyes pa/ ma 'gags pa/ dri ma med pa/ dri ma dang bral ba med pa/ bri ba med pa/ gang ba med pa'o zhes pas bstan/ de'i don/ shā ri'i bu zhes bsnan pa'i tshul gyi bos nas/ gzugs sogs 'khor 'das thams cad mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du 'dug pa de ltar na chos thams cad zab mo stong pa nyid de yum gyi don no/ /'dir stong nyid kyi don cung zad brjod na/ sems gsal rig gi ngo bo la bltas pas/ dang po skye sa ma rnyed/ bar du gnas sa ma rnyed/ tha mar 'gag sa ma rnyed pa skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba de la/ 'di dang 'di'o zhes yid kyis bsam ma shes/ ma shes pas ngag gis smra ma shes/ rgyu mtshan des na sgras brjod pa dang rtog pa'i yul las 'das pas stong nyid nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor yum shes rab gyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhig la 'dod de/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de lta bu'i stong nyid zab mo de mtshon byed gang gis kyang mtshon du med pas na mtshan nyid med pa/ stong nyid rgyu rkyen gyis 'phral du ma bskyed pa'i ye nas stong pas na ma skyes pa/ stong nyid rang gi ngo bo ma skyes kyang rtsal cir yang mi 'gag pas na ma 'gags pa/ stong nyid zab mo'i gshis la 'khrul pa'i dri ma gdod ma nas med pas na dri ma med pa/ dri ma de yang 'phral la bsal ba ma yin gyi ye nas dag pa yin pas na dri ma dang bral ba med pa/ stong nyid zab mo'i gshis lugs rang bzhin lhun grub kyis sangs rgyas la skyon yon bsal bzhag dang bral zhing / gang stong dang 'phel 'grib med pas na bri ba med pa/ gang ba med pa'o/ /gsum pa 'khor 'das yul gyi 'dzin pa las grol tshul la/

phung po lnga'i grol tshul/ dbang po drug yul drug khams bco brgyad/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis/ bden pa bzhi/ sku dang ye shes kyi grol tshul dang bdun no/ /dang po ni shā ri'i bu zhes sogs kyis bstan/ de'i don shā ri'i bu zhes bos nas/ rtogs pa zab mo brgyad ldan du grol ba de lta bas na zab mo stong pa nyid kyi gshis lugs la/ gzugs med/ tshor ba med/ 'du shes med/ 'du byed med/ rnam par shes pa med zhes stong pa nyid kyi gshis lugs la gzugs sogs med pa snang med kyi rnal 'byor dngos bstan dang / stong pa nyid kyi 'char sgo la gzugs sogs 'khor 'das kyi chos cir yang 'char ba snang bcas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ stong pa nyid la gzugs yod/ tshor ba yod/ 'du shes yod/ 'du byed yod/ rnam par shes pa yod ces pa dang / stong pa nyid gzugs sogs su snang yang stong nyid kho rang las gzhan pa'i gzugs med/ tshor ba med/ 'du shes med/ 'du byed med/ rnam par shes pa med ces zung 'jug bgrod pa gcig pa'i nyams len sbas don du gnas pas te/ dngos bstan dang sbas don gnyis kyi sgo nas snang bcas snang med zung 'jug gsum gyi 'chad tshul 'di ni/ thal rang shing rta'i srol 'byed dag gis sher phyin zab mo'i mdo 'chad pa'i dgongs pa kho bo'i rnam dpyod kyi rtsal las rnyed pa yin pas blo gros dang ldan pa dag dga' bar gyis shig stong nyid gzugs sogs su shar yang kho rang las gzhan pa'i gzugs sogs su med pa sbas don yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ stong pa nyid gzugs so/ /stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no zhes pa'i mdo don phyin ci ma log pa ste gnad kyi don no/ /'chad tshul 'di ni don tshan 'og ma rnams la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /kha cig mdo'i don gzugs sogs gtan med zhes 'chad pa ni chad pa'i mthar lhung zhing / gzhan dag gzugs sogs bden par med ces 'chad pa ni khyad gzhi dang khyad chos go log ste stong nyid zab mo'i don la blo kha ma phyogs so/

/gnyis pa dbang po drug gi grol tshul ni/ stong nyid rang ngo 'phrod pas stong pa nyid kyi gshis la/ mig med/ rna ba med/ sna med/ lce med/ lus med/ yid med ces pa'o/ /gsum pa yul drug gi grol tshul ni/ de ltar yul can gyi dbang po drug yul la ma rgyus pas yul gzugs sgra sogs drug tu 'dzin pa med de/ gzugs med/ sgra med/ dri med/ ro med/ reg bya med/ chos med do zhes pa'o/ /bzhi pa khams bco brgyad kyi grol tshul ni/ dbang po drug rtog med du shar/ yul drug rang snang du shes/ rnam shes tshogs drug gi 'dzin pa chod pas te/ mig gi khams med pa nas yid kyi khams med/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi bar du yang med do zhes so/ /lnga pa brten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi grol tshul ni/ ma rig pa med/ ma rig pa zad pa med pa nas rga shi med/ rga shi zad pa'i bar du yang med do zhes pas bstan/ 'di'i don mdor bsdu na/ dngos bstan stong nyid zab mo'i gshis la kun byang gi rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis grub pa med kyang / sbas don stong nyid kyi 'char sgo la kun nas nyon mongs kyi rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis/ lugs 'byung du shar ba las 'khor bar 'khyams tshul dang / rnam byang gi rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis lugs ldog tu shar ba las grol ba mya ngan las 'das pa thob tshul gnyis su 'dus mod/ de yang cung zad bshad na/ kun nas nyon mongs kyi rten 'brel las 'khor ba 'byung tshul dang / rnam byang gi rten 'brel las mya 'das thob tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ sems nyid bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po rang bzhin rnam dag gi sangs rgyas su ye nas gnas kyang lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pas rang ngo ma shes shing ma rig ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed kyi las bsags te/ rnam par shes pa rig rig por shar/ rnam par shes pas yul spu ris su bcad de 'di ni 'di'o/ /pha gi ni pha gi'o zhes shes par byed/

gang du shes na ming dang gzugs su shes/ gang gis shes na skye mched drug gis shes/ ming gzugs las skye mched mched pas/ yul dbang phrad pa'i reg pa byung / reg pas tshor ba nyams su myong / myong bas sred pa skyes/ sred pas mngal du zhugs/ zhugs pas srid pa 'khor bar lus len/ lus blangs pas skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba la sogs pa 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi phung po 'ba' zhig pa 'di byung ngo / /gnyis pa rnam byang gi rten 'brel las myang 'das thob tshul ni/ bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gis gnas lugs zab mo ngo sprad pa las/ ma rig pa yul med du dag 'du byed rtsa ba dang bral/ rnam par shes pa rang stong du yal te/ ming dang gzugs su ma bzung / ma bzung bas skye mched drug rang snang du dag dag pas yul la rang rgyud du ma reg ma reg pas tshor ba nyams su ma myong / ma myong bas myong ba la sred pa ma skyes/ ma sred pas mngal du ma zhugs te srid pa 'khor bar lus mi len/ lus ma blangs pas skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal las grol ba'i mya ngan las 'das pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /'o na 'dir srid pa'i 'og tu len pa bshad pa dang / mdo bstan bcos phal mo che las len pa'i 'og tu srid pa bshad pa gnyis go rim 'gal lo zhe na/ mi 'gal te/ srid pa'i sgra 'jug pa'i yul la/ 'khor ba 'grub byed kyi las la srid par bshad pa dang / srid pa 'khor ba zhes 'khor ba spyi la srid par bshad pa gnyis las/ mdo bstan bcos las bshad pa ni go rim dang po'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ 'dir ni phyi ma'i dbang du byas pa yin pas skyon med do/ /drug pa bden pa bzhi'i grol tshul ni/ de bzhin du sdug bsngal ba dang / kun 'byung ba dang / 'gog pa dang / lam med zhes pas bstan/ de yang zab mo stong pa nyid kyi gshis la sdug bsngal gsum ci rigs pas bsdus pa'i sdug bsngal ba dang / zag bcas kyi las nyon gang rung gis bsdus pa'i kun 'byung ba dang /

sdug kun 'gags pa'i 'gog pa dang / 'gog pa thob phyir du brtson pa'i lam med kyang / stong pa nyid kyi 'char sgo la sdug kun rgyu 'bras kyis bsdus pa'i 'khor ba dang / 'gog lam rgyu 'bras kyis bsdus pa'i myang 'das 'char zhes pa'o/ /bdun pa sku dang ye shes kyi grol tshul ni/ ye shes med/ thob pa med/ ma thob pa yang med do zhes pas bstan/ de'i don dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i ngang du rig pa ye shes thim nas shes bya shes byed kyi rtog pa las 'das te mkhyen pa'i ye shes rang rgyud pa med pas ye shes med ces dang / de ltar rang snang 'khrul pa grol ba tsam las logs su sangs rgyas zhes bya ba kha mig rna ba can 'thob rgyu med pas thob pa med ces dang / de lta na yang smon lam gyi dbang gis gzhan snang la gzugs kyi sku mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa/ gdul bya la mi 'gag par snang bas na ma thob pa yang med do zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa sbas don gsal rig sems kyi ldog pa nas bshad tshul ni/ sngar bshad pa'i don tshan de dag 'di ltar yang sbyar te/ gzugs sems so/ /sems nyid gzugs so/ /gzugs las sems gzhan ma yin no/ /de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa rnams so/ /shā ri'i bu de ltar chos thams cad sems nyid de/ mtshan nyid med pa/ zhes sogs su sbyor tshul sbas don no/ /'dir smras pa/ de ltar stong nyid zab mo la/ /snang med snang bcas zung 'jug gsum/ /sbyar ba'i dngos bstan 'chad tshul dang / /sbas don gsal rig sems la yang / /tshul de legs par sbyar ba yi/ /thun mong ma yin 'chad tshul drug /rgyas par mkhas pa'i ngag las dris/ /dpang du rgyal ba'i mdo nyid zungs/ /dpang po gzhan gyi spyod yul min/ /zhes so/ /'o na snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gi sems su 'dus/ gsal rig sems kyi ngo bo la ngos bzung med pas stong pa nyid du ro gcig

stong gsal sems kyi 'char sgo la 'khor 'das thams cad 'byung bar gang las shes zhe na/ rnam dpyod dang ldan pa dag rna ba blags te nyon cig don 'di la kho bo'i blo gros dbyar mtsho'i chu ltar rgyas yod pas go bde'i ngag gis brjod par bya'o/ /de yang snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gi sems su 'dus te/ rgyal ba'i sras po zhi ba lhas/ lcags sreg sa gzhi su yis byas/ /me tshogs de dag ci las byung / /de 'dra de dag thams cad ni/ /sdig sems yin par thub pas gsungs/ /zhes dang / de'i shugs la/ grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pas/ /mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa yang / /dge sems yin par thub pas gsungs/ /zhes pa zhig thob pa dang / rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas med cing sems can med/ /ces sogs rgya cher gsungs pa las shes so/ /gnyis pa sems gsal rig gi ngo bo la ngos bzung med pas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du ro gcig ste/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub kyis/ rten cing 'brel 'byung ma gtogs pa'i/ /chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no/ /de phyir stong nyid ma gtogs pa'i/ /chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes dang / brgyad khri bzhi stong chos rnams kun/ /stong nyid 'di la gzhol zhing 'bab/ /ces sogs gsungs so/ /gsum pa stong gsal sems kyi 'char sgo la 'khor 'das thams cad 'byung ba yang 'thad de/ chos mngon pa'i mdo las/ thog ma med pa'i dus kyi dbyings/ /chos rnams kun gyi gnas yin te/ /de yod pas na 'gro kun dang / /mya ngan 'das pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / bram ze chen po sa ra has/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te/ /gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster bar byed pa yi/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs shing / de'i shugs la/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te/

/gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba/ /mi 'dod ngan 'gro'i gnas su skyur byed pa'i/ /phung byed sems la yid 'byung the le le/ /zhes pa yang shugs la thob bo/ /de sogs shes byed kyi lung 'ga' yod kyang yi ge mang ba'i 'jigs pas 'dir ma bris so/ /mdor na thar pa don gnyer gyi bzo bo mkhas pa dag rang sems rin po che gser gyi rgyu cha 'di la gzugs brnyan ji ltar bzos kyang rgyu cha las g.yo ma shes pa dang / gang bzo rang gis shes shing rang dbang yod pa dang / rgyu cha logs nas 'tshol mi dgos pa'i don soms dang / de lta bu'i gnas lugs zab mo zhig rang ngo 'phrod pas phyi na 'dre med/ nang na lha med/ 'khor 'das la mgo snyoms byung / spang gnyen gyi rdzun phugs rdib/ gang shar chos sku'i rol pa las g.yo mi shes pa'i dga' ba la ang / kho bos ni mtshan ldan gyi bla ma'i zab don gyi bdud rtsi mos gus kyi snyems pas ngoms par 'thungs pa las blo gros kyi lus stobs che cher rgyas pa yin no/ /sher phyin theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa dngos grub dpal 'bar gnas lugs zab mo'i don la nges pa gting nas brnyes pas spros dga' khong nas rgyas pa'i bro zhig skabs 'dir khrob dang he he/ 'dir smras pa/ chos kun rang gi sems su 'dus/ /rang sems stong pa'i gshis lugs 'di/ /'khor 'das gang du'ang ma grub kyang / /stong gsal sems kyi 'char sgo la/ /dge sdig blang dor byas pa'i mthus/ /'khor 'das gnyis kyi shor thob byung / /de phyir zab mo'i lta ba la/ /rang ngo 'phrod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sdig spong dge la brtson pa zhig /yid bzhin nor 'dra sems nyid kyi/ /gnas lugs shes pa'i mthu las 'byung / /de lta bas na thar 'dod rnams/ /gcig shes kun la mkhas pa yi/ /chig chog rgyal po chos kyi mchog /gnas lugs don la gzhol bar gyis/ /zhes 'di snying gtam gces pa'i tshig /ces so//

//bzhi pa sher phyin nyams su blang bar gdams pa ni/ shā ri'i bu de lta bas na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la thob pa med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la brten cing gnas te zhes pas bstan/ de'i don shā ri'i bu zhes bos te/ yum don rtogs pa tsam gyis grol bar bshad pa de lta bas na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'bras bu logs nas thob par byar med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di ston pa'i bla ma la brten cing des bstan pa'i don nyams su len pa la gnas dgos te/ gnas na 'og nas 'chad pa'i phan yon rnams 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa sher phyin nyams su blangs pa'i phan yon ni/ sems la sgrib pa med pas skrag pa med de phyin ci log las shin tu 'das nas yongs su mya ngan 'das pa'i mthar phyin to zhes pas bstan/ de'i don/ yum don rtogs na sems la sgrib pa gsum gyis sgrib pa med pas/ sgrib pa las byung ba'i sdug bsngal gyis sems rgyud skrag pa med de/ phyin ci log 'khor ba'i gnas las shin tu 'das nas/ yongs su mi nyams pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i mthar phyin to zhes so/ /gsum pa sher phyin dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum du bstan pa ni/ dus gsum du rnam par bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la brten nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /zhes pas bstan/ de'i don/ dus gsum du rnam par bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ 'das ma 'ongs da ltar gyi sangs rgyas byung ngo cog thams cad yin/ de dag gang la brten nas sangs rgyas na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo'i don 'di nyams su blangs pa la brten nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /rgyu mtshan de lta bas na rjes 'jug sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa rnams kyis kyang sher phyin zab mo'i don nyams su blang ba la brtson par bya dgos so zhes pa'o/

/de skad du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sdud pa tshigs su bcad pa las/ rgyal ba 'das dang ma byon da ltar gang bzhugs pa/ /kun lam pha rol phyin pa 'di yin gzhan ma yin/ /zhes gsungs/ sher phyin dus gsum rgyal ba mtha' dag gi yum yin tshul gyi don cung zad brjod na/ yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes pa ni/ thog ma med pa'i dus nas yod pa'i chos/ gsal stong zung du 'jug pa'i dbyings/ 'khor 'das 'ching grol kun gyi gzhi/ skyon yon bsal gzhag dang bral ba'i spros bral skye 'gro mtha' dag gi rgyud kyis ma bsdus pa'i rig stong gnyis su med pa'i zag med kyi ye shes rgyud gcig nyid la 'jog gi skye 'gro so so'i rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i chos nyid tsam la ni mi 'jog ste/ de ni phyogs ris su chad pa dang / brtan g.yo kun la ma khyab pa dang / 'das ma 'ongs kyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi yum du bzhag tu mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /yum sher phyin de nyid dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi yum yin pa dang / yum de nyid rten gyi gang zag kun la khyab kyang / so so'i rgyud kyis ma bsdus pa'i phyogs ris dang bral zhing gcig tu grub pa dang / nam mkhas phyogs bcu kun la khyab kyang nam mkha' la dbye ba med pa bzhin du/ gsal stong zung 'jug gi yum gyis brtan g.yo kun la khyab kyang gsal stong gi chos dbyings la dbye ba med pa dang tsan+dan dang shug pa la sogs pa'i ljon pa sna tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i nags tshal la shar ri nas nyi ma shar ba'i tshe rang rang gi ngo skal gyi grib ma mi 'dra bar snang yang / nub rir nyi ma nub pa'i tshe grib ma zhes par ro gcig pa bzhin du skye 'gro mtha' dag gi rgyud la yum gyi don cha 'dra tshang ba'i gsal stong gi chos nyid nyi tshe ba re yod pa yum don la ngo 'phrod pa'i tshe/ kun khyab chos kyi dbyings gcig nyid du ro gcig pa dang / de'i rgyun goms shing nyams su blangs pa las glo bur gyi dri ma ma lus pa dang bral ba'i tshe spangs rtogs mthar thug gi 'dres pa chen po'i sangs rgyas thob zhes pa'i tha snyad 'dogs shing /

de lta na yang rje btsun gyis/ ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin/ /'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sngar slob pa'i gnas skabs kyi kun khyab chos dbyings kyi yum dang / phyis mi slob pa'i gnas skabs kyi kun khyab chos dbyings kyi yum gnyis bzang ngan du 'gyur ba ci skad cig kyang med do/ /don de dag kyang sher phyin sdud pa las/ gang dag 'das dang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mgon gang dang / /ma 'ongs dus na 'byung 'gyur de dag 'di las byung / /'jig rten ston pa rgyal ba rnams kyi skyed byed yum/ /sems can gzhan gyi sems kyi spyod pa ston par byed/ /'jig rten de bzhin nyid dang dgra bcom de bzhin nyid/ /rang rgyal de bzhin nyid dang rgyal sras de bzhin nyid/ /gcig pa nyid de dngos bral gzhan min de bzhin nyid/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa de bzhin gshegs pas mkhyen/ /zhes dang / nam mkha'i khams ni shar gyi phyogs dang lho phyogs dang / /de bzhin nub kyi phyogs dang byang phyogs pa mtha' yas/ /steng dang 'og dang phyogs bcu ji snyed rnams na'ang yod/ /tha dad gyur pa med cing bye brag gyur pa med/ /'das pa'i de bzhin nyid gang ma byon de bzhin nyid/ /da ltar de bzhin nyid gang dgra bcom de bzhin nyid/ /chos kun de bzhin nyid gang rgyal ba'i de bzhin nyid/ /chos kyi de bzhin nyid 'di thams cad bye brag med/ /ces dang / dper na 'dzam bu'i gling na shing rnams bye ba stong / /rnam pa sna tshogs rnam pa du ma gzugs mang ba/ /grib mar gyur pa'i grangs su brjod pa ma gtogs pa'i/ /grib ma sna tshogs med cing bye brag yod ma yin/ /de bzhin rgyal ba'i pha rol phyin lnga 'di dag kyang / /shes rab pha rol phyin pa ming nyid thob par 'gyur/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid phyir yongs su bsngo byas na/ /byang chub ces byar drug po 'di kun ro gcig 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/

/tshul 'di lta bu'i 'chad tshul ni/ ding sang gi mdo don smra ba dag gi blo yul du shong ba dka' mod/ de lta na yang sher phyin zab mo'i brjod don nyams su len pa la med du mi rung ba'i chos zhig yin pas blo gros dang ldan pa dag gis gces spras su byos shigs/ bzhi pa yum sher phyin sngags dang gnyis su med par bstan pa la/ sher phyin gyi che ba/ de'i sngags dngos/ de la slobs shig par gdams pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ de lta bas na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngags/ rig pa chen po'i sngags/ bla na med pa'i sngags/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa byed pa'i sngags/ sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i sngags/ mi rdzun pas na bden par shes par bya ste zhes pas bstan/ de'i don dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad sher phyin la brten nas sangs rgyas dgos na/ sangs rgya ba la gsang sngags zab mo'i lam mi dgos sam zhe na/ dgos mod/ yum don rtogs na grol bar bshad pa de lta bas na sher phyin la sngags kyi don tshang ste/ sngags kyi skad dod du man tra zhes 'byung la/ de'i don mtshan rtog las yid skyob pa la 'jug cing / sher phyin zab mo'i rtogs pa skyes pa'i tshe mtshan 'dzin gyi rnam rtog mtha' dag las grol bas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngags/ gnyis snang gi ma rig pa yul med du dag pas rig pa chen po'i sngags/ sher phyin las mchog tu gyur pa'i lam gzhan med pas bla na med pa'i sngags/ yum don rtogs na sngar ma mnyam pa spangs rtogs mthar thug gi sangs rgyas dang mnyam par byed pas na mi mnyam pa dang mnyam par byed pa'i sngags/ rgyu las dang 'bras bu sdug bsngal thams cad nye bar zhi bar byed pas na sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i sngags so/ /yum don rtogs na yon tan de lta bu 'byung ba mi bslu bar nges pas mi rdzun pas na bden par shes par bya ste zhes so/

/gnyis pa sngags dngos ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngags smras pa/ zhes smra bar zhal gyis bzhes nas/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ga te ga te/ pā ra ga te/ pā ra saṃ ga te bho dhi ye swāhā/ zhes so/ /de'i don/ tad+ya thā ni 'di lta ste/ oṃ ni/ don brgyad la 'jug kyang 'dir bkra shis pa'i don no/ /ga te ga te ni song song ste lam ma zhugs nas tshogs lam du song / tshogs lam nas sbyor lam du song / pā ra ga te ni mchog tu song zhes pas sbyor lam nas mthong lam du song / pā ra saṃ ga te ni mchog tu yang dag par song zhes pa mthong lam nas bsgom lam du song / bho dhi swāhā ni/ byang chub kyi gzhi tshugs zhes pa bsgom lam nas byang chub chen po'i gzhi tshugs pa mi slob lam du song ba'o/ /gsum pa de la slobs shig par gdams pa ni/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo la bslab par bya'o/ /zhes pas bstan/ de'i don/ shā ri'i bu zhes bos nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sngags dang sher phyin gyi don gnyis su med pa de ltar shes par byas nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo'i don nyams su len pa la bslab par bya dgos te/ sangs rgya ba la thabs shes gnyis dgos shing / sher phyin ni shes rab gtso che/ gsang sngags thabs gtso che ba'i phyir ro// //gnyis pa zhal nas gsungs pa'i bka' ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la legs so zhes bya ba byin nas/ legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ ji ltar khyod kyis bstan pa de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol phyin pa zab mo la spyad par bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyang rjes su yi rang ngo / /zhes pas bstan/ de'i don la/ ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs pa dang legs so byin pa gnyis/

dang po ni/ dri ba dris lan rdzogs pa'i rjes de nas bcom ldan 'das zab mo snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te/ zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la ston pas legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ rjod byed kyi tshig kyang khyod kyis bstan pa de bzhin du legs so/ /brjod bya'i don yang khyod kyis bstan pa de de bzhin du legs so/ /zhes dang / rigs kyi bu zhes 'khor rnam bzhi bos nas/ spyan ras gzigs kyis bstan pa de ji lta ba bzhin du yum gyi don yin no/ /de de bzhin te/ zhes pa ni/ yin pa tsam gyis mi chog de la slob dgos zhes pa'o/ /des na ji ltar spyan ras gzigs khyod kyi bstan pa de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo la spyad par bya ste/ spyan ras gzigs khyod kyis thub pa'i dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par lon pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar 'khor rnam bzhis yum don nyams su blangs na dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyang rjes su yi rang ngo zhes yi rang bar byed de/ yum de dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa rjes su gnang ba'i bka' ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' bstsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ra dwa ti'i bu dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rang ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /zhes pas bstan/ de'i don/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gong du bshad pa de skad ces legs so byin pa bka' bstsal nas/ de'i rjes su 'khor rnams kyis bcom ldan la rjes su yi rang byas so/ /'khor gang gis zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ra dwa ti'i bu dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang /

'khor rnam bzhi thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten rnams bcom ldan 'das la rjes su yi rang ste spro zhing dad nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //gsum pa zab mo'i nyams len gnad kyi bsdus don bstan pa la/ mnyam bzhag ting nge 'dzin gsum ldan du bsgom pa dang / rjes thob bgrod pa gcig pa'i 'khyer so gnyis/ dang po la stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin/ mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sems kyis sems la bltas pas sems de cir yang ma grub pa nam mkha' lta bu yin te/ de ltar yang nam mkha' lta bu yin te/ nye bar zhi spyod pa zhes so/ /ji ltar nam mkha' dang 'dra zhe na/ dang por skye bas stong ste byung sa med/ tha ma 'gag pas stong ste 'gro sa med/ bar du gnas pas stong ste ngos gzung med pa nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /de ltar yang / skye ba med dang skye ba gnyis char mi rtog pa/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ /zhes so/ /mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ de ltar sems kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du 'dug pas bsgom pa'i tshe na dmigs pa can nam mtshan ma can du sgom du med de/ gshis spros bral gyi steng du blo bya bral du 'jog pa yin no/ /de ltar yang / mtshan ma med par gnas zhing zhi la rab zhir spyod/ /ces so/ /mtshan ma med par ji ltar bsgom snyam na/ bsgom bya'i blo dang bral/ bsgom byed kyi mkhan po med/ bsgom pa dang mi bsgom pa'i rtsis btab dang bral nas sems ma bcos par rjen ne gzhag par bya'o/ /de ltar yang / de chos kun la mi gnas gnas pa med par spyod/ /ces so/ /smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ de ltar sems kyi ngo bo skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba/ smra bsam brjod med kyi don de kho na la/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub bya ba yang de la zer ba yin gyi/ de bas gzhan pa'i yar la 'bras bu thob bya smon pa gzhan med/ ces so/ /don de rtogs na 'khor bar ltung mkhan med de/ kun 'byung ba med/ sdug bsngal med ces so/ /don de lta bu rtogs na/ sa lam cig car du chod cing rim par bgrod mi dgos te/ lam med ces so/ /mdor na chos thams cad sems kyi rang snang du rtogs pas phyi'i sgro 'dogs chod/ sems kyi rang bzhin cir yang ma grub pa stong pa nyid du rtogs pas nang gi sgro 'dogs chod/ stong pa nyid la lta rgyu dang nyams su len rgyu ci yang ma rnyed pas rig pa rang babs su khrol le bzhag pas gsang ba'i sgro 'dogs chod/ don de nyid las ma rtogs pa'i bsgrub bya gzhan na med pas mthar thug gi sgro 'dogs chod/ sgro 'dogs thams cad dang bral ba'i sems de mtha' bral du gnas pa nyams len gyi mchog yin no/ /de ltar yang / gnas med gnas yin 'di ni rgyal bas gnas par gsungs/ /dper na bar snang sprin bzhin gnas pa med par gnas/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i ngang la ma yengs par gnas pa ni/ mnyam bzhag zhes bya zhing / mnyam par gzhag rgyu med pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag ste/ de ltar yang bdag ni mnyam par bzhag ce'am langs zhes rloms sems med/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos kyi rang bzhin yongs shes phyir/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa rjes thob bgrod pa gcig pa'i 'khyer so la/ mdo rang rkang gi nyams len dkyus su bshad/ thabs ldan mchog gi nyams len zur nas bkang / spros byas dmigs pa'i ldog pa spros med du shar tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ de ltar mnyam bzhag las rjes thob tu langs pa de'i tshe gzugs sogs snang ba thams cad snang stong zhen pa dang bral ba sgyu ma lta bur lam du 'khyer/ sgra brag cha thams cad grag stong zhen pa dang bral ba brag cha lta bur lam du 'khyer/ dran snang rtog pa'i ri mo thams cad rig stong dbyer med rmi lam lta bur lam du 'khyer ro/

/de ltar yang / gang zhig chos 'di sprul dang sgyu ma 'drar shes shing / /som nyi med cing slob la phyir zhing sbyor byed pa/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa thabs ldan mchog gi nyams len zur nas bkang ba ni/ rang nyid gsang sngags zab mo'i nyams len gtso bor byed pa zhig yin na/ rang gsal stong dbyer med kyi bskyed rim la gnas nas snang ba thams cad de ltar du lam du 'khyer bar byed dgos la/ 'di la yang yi dam gyi lha gcig nyid kyi bskyed rim la chig sgril byas/ lta ba zab mo'i rtsis zin na lam chod che zhing / mang po'i nyams len gyis dgos khar phan chung ba'i dpe ni/ rmi lam dang bar do'i snang ba 'tshub bo zhig shar ba'i tshe chig sgril byas pa'i skyes bu de/ bskyed rdzogs gcig pu de nyams su len pa la brtson zhing des phan thogs la/ mang po'i nyams len byed pa'i gang zag de la sngar gyi snang ba de lta bu shar ba'i tshe/ bskyed rdzogs gcig la rnam rtog gting tshugs pa'i yid brtan thub pa med pas blang bya'i nyams len rtsab rtsob tu 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa spros bcas dmigs pa'i ldog pa mang du shar tshul ni/ mdo rang rkang gi nyams len ltar na/ snang stong dbyer med kyi ngang ngam/ sngags kyi nyams len ltar na bskyed rim zab mo'i ngang nas/ mdo dag par ston pa'i rjes su bzlog pa byed pa'i tshe/ lag pa g.yas pa nyi ma/ g.yon pa zla bar bsams te/ bstan pa spyi dang sems can yongs la 'tshe ba dang / bla ma dang rnal 'byor pa rang gi phrin las dang / sa lam bsgrub pa'i bar du gcod pa'i gnod byed rnams la tshad med pa'i snying rje drag pos kun nas bslangs te/ thal mo brdab pa'i tshe nyi zla'i bar du lus ngag thal ba rdul du brlag cing rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su bsgral bar bsam/ rjes gong du bshad pa'i lta ba zab mo la mnyam par bzhag go /'dir smras pa/ mnyam bzhag srid zhi gnyis kyi rtog dpyod bral/ /rjes thob yul snang sgyu mar nyams su myong /

/mnyam rjes bgrod pa gcig pa'i nyams len la/ /nges pa gting nas rnyed pa bla ma'i drin/ /gdon 'drer 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog dbyings su yal/ /bgegs bar chad kyi 'tshum ma rang sar zhi/ /sems ma bcos stong pa'i ngang du grol/ /gdon rigs chos skyong du 'gyur ba bla ma'i drin/ /bar chad dngos grub du longs pa bla ma'i drin/ /rang sems sangs rgyas su shes pa bla ma'i drin/ /zhes so/ /zab mo'i nyams len mtha' dag gi don nyung ngu'i tshig gi sgo nas bsdu na/ 'di ltar du nyams su blang ste/ phyi tshogs drug yul snang sna tshogs la/ /nang 'gyu ba sems kyi 'dzin pa bral/ /bar snang stong sgyu ma'i rol rtsed kyis/ /nyams gang skyes bde ba'i rol par shar/ /blo cig sgril thub pa bla ma'i drin/ /de ltar du nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /de ltar dngos bstan sbas ston gyi/ /'chad tshul nyin byed dbang po las/ /legs bshad tsha zer 'phros pa yis/ /sher phyin brjod don pad+mo'i tshal/ /legs bshad ge sar phye ba las/ /byung ba'i zab don sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ /don gnyer rkang drug ldan rnams kyi/ /blo gros lus stobs rgyas phyir sbyin/ /dge bas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun/ /zab mo'i gnas la gzhol byas te/ /rnam grol byang chub myur thob shog /ces pa 'di nyid chu pho spre'u'i lo/ nyin mo'i dbang phyug bu mo'i khyim du rtsed dgas rol pa'i dkar po'i phyogs bzang po gsum pa'i tshes zla bas gro zhun khyim du bsu ba'i 'grub sbyor la/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang byang phyogs dpal gyi ri las stong rgyal gyi shrī ri'i bsam gtan gling gi gnas chen du sher phyin theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa dngos grub dpal 'bar gyis sde snod 'dzin pa 'ga' dang 'ga' yis bskul ba'i ngor gzhan phan gyi blo kho nas bkod pa 'dis/ snying po don gyi bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas par gyur cig/ //'phrul yig mkhan po bkra shis dpal bzang gis/

/brda dag dang bcas gus pas legs par bris/ /rkos la mkhas pa bskal bzang rdo rje dang / /mkha' spyod rdo rje sku mched gnyis kyis brkos/ /spar 'di'i mthun rkyen mtha' dag sgrub byed ni/ /gzhan sde dpung tshogs bzhi yis zil gyis gnon/ /rang bde byams pa'i rwa bar skyong mkhas shing / /bstan pa stobs kyis 'dzin pa'i brgya byin che/ /sman khab stod kyi sa skyong sku mched yin/ /de ltar bskrun pa'i rab dkar dge tshogs kyis/ /mi dbang sku tshe bskal 'bangs dpal 'byor sogs/ /phun tshogs dbyar mtsho'i chu ltar rgyas pa dang / /gnas skabs 'gal rkyen nyer 'tshe kun zhi nas/ /mthar thug rdzogs pa'i byang chub myur thob shog/ //maṅga laṃ bha wan+tu/ shu bhaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 dngos grub dpal 'bar/ rgyal yum snying po'i rnam bshad/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
